identified_issues: Violation of Pharmacy Robotic Dispensing SOP 12.1 Requirement 3: Missing predecessor review state binding hash in robotic compounding dispatch payload.
Technician's assertion of full verification contradicts the operational payload data showing a null predecessor review event hash.
evidence: Pharmacy Robotic Dispensing SOP 12.1 Requirement 3 explicitly mandates that 'Each robotic compounding execution must be verifiably bound to the exact clinical order verification state established during pharmacist review, using the review event hash recorded in the clinical order registry.'

Pharmacist Verification Console Log (PHARM_STATION_03) recorded SHA-256 Digest 'd4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0' for EVENT_PHARM_VERIFY_991 at 2026-10-06T10:14:22.180Z.
Robotic Compounding Dispatch Payload (MSG_DISPATCH_8842) contains 'predecessor_review_event_hash': null, failing the required cryptographic binding.
recommended_action: Halt robotic compounding for order CHEMO_8842 immediately. Reject the dispatch message at the automated queue validator, update the dispatch payload generator to populate 'predecessor_review_event_hash' with the verified digest 'd4a8e235cc084e9121f087da29b71e16f5c889a0b1273891d4e08219ab6019b0', and re-validate all three SOP 12.1 criteria before releasing the order to ROBO_COMPOUND_A.
